findings.summary: AI-generated PR, closed on sight under the org policy
No linked issue; no CHANGES.rst entry or versionchanged notes
str(o) is wrong for PathLike objects like DirEntry; should be os.fspath
Changes the documented type list the JSON provider serializes; no reason it belongs in core, override default instead
Body falsely claims PathLike serialization matches stdlib behavior
Dataclass change only swaps one TypeError message for another; not a real fix
Fails the repo's ruff import-order and format checks
Tests import inside functions unlike the file, and don't cover non-pathlib PathLike

why: Finding 1 states the AI-policy ground the maintainer cited, and findings 4 and 6 also state the 'no more types' and 'different error isn't a bug' reasons. A maintainer reading finding 1 alone would close it.
